shotsInfo.name: Overnight
shotsInfo.note: Time-lapse from two Kling 3.0 4K clips: lid open at 10 pm (s3a 0-12), hard cut to the lid shut through the night as the sky goes gray-blue (s3b 25-82), hard cut to the lid open before dawn (s3b 112-120). The frames where the clips swing the lid on its own (s3a 35-55, s3b 86-110) are never used, and the picks skip the firebox flare frames. Night steps picked for even smoke motion (firebox excluded) and no flare frames.

shotsInfo.note: Three held stills joined by hard cuts (phase A fallback, approved). Review fixes: the first two stills share one continuous push-in (1.00->1.12 about (0.56, 0.66), constant ratio per frame across the cut, the package still aligned to the first still's background), so the cut changes only the meat; s4-4 and s4-5 retouched (both package ends folded tight; grease as amber patches soaked through, not red drops); phone crops show the point (s4-1), the folded end (s4-4) and the tucked end on the pit (s4-5). Round 3: the phone crop pans linearly from left edge 0.43 to 0.49 over s4-1 and holds 0.49 on s4-4, so there is no sideways jump at 173|174 and the folded end sits inside the cover-fit window on tall phones.

shotsInfo.name: Slice
shotsInfo.note: Slice saw (2026-11-01): Kling 3.0 4K s5s.mp4, pinned s5c-start-saw (slice attached, slicer edge on the bark a pencil-width in, guide hand flat on the brisket) -> s5c-end-saw (new slice leaning on the stack). Src 0-108: long sawing strokes, guide hand still. Src 109-113 are not used: the falling slice ghosts (two smeared copies). The shot jumps from the slice upright at the board (108) to resting on the stack (114). 36 sawing frames picked for even direct flow, then 114/116/118/120.
